    tan(pi * (2 * k + 1)) = 0
    tan(pi - 2 * pi * k) = 0
    tan(pi / 4 + k * pi) = 1
    cot(-pi / 4 - j * pi) = -1
    sin((k - j) * pi) = 0
    cos(pi / 2 + k * pi) = 0

    sin(pi / 2 + 2 * k * pi) = 1

    cos(5 * pi / 6 - 2 * j * pi) = -sqrt(3) / 2

import hashlib
import json
import runpy
import subprocess
import sys
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
draft = root / 'tmp/2026-10-03/exact-numeric-periodic-trig-modulus'
digest_source = runpy.run_path(str(root / 'examples/test_objs/run.py'))['source_digest']
source_before = digest_source(root)
build = subprocess.run(['cargo', 'build', '--release'], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
record = {'schema_version': 1, 'task': 'Exact numeric, periodic trig and complex modulus', 'source_sha256': source_before, 'build_exit_code': build.returncode, 'build_log': build.stdout + build.stderr}
phase = sys.argv[1]
path = draft / (phase + '.json')
if build.returncode != 0 or digest_source(root) != source_before:
    record['source_stable'] = digest_source(root) == source_before
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    raise SystemExit('Build failed or inputs changed; acceptance probes not executed.')
binary = root / 'target/release/litex'
record['binary_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
shutil.copy2(binary, draft / ('litex-' + phase + '-verified'))
cases = {
    'periodic_tangent': ('have k Z\ntan(pi + 2*k*pi) = 0', True),
    'negative_power': ('2^(-3) = 1/8\n(-2)^(-3) = -1/8\neval 2^(-3)', True),
    'fraction_order': ('1/3 < 1/2\nmin(1/3,1/2) = 1/3\nmax(1/3,1/2) = 1/2', True),
    'numeric_modulus_layouts': ('C_abs(3+4*i)=5\nC_abs(4*i+3)=5\nC_abs(3-4*i)=5\nC_abs(-4*i+3)=5', True),
    'tangent_pole': ('tan(pi/2) = 0', False),
    'noninteger_period': ('have k R\ntan(pi+2*k*pi)=0', False),
    'zero_negative_power': ('let x = 0^(-1)', False),
    'zero_denominator': ('1/0 < 1/2', False),
    'wrong_modulus': ('C_abs(3+4*i) = -5', False),
}
record['observations'] = []
for name, (code, intended) in cases.items():
    command = [str(binary), '-strict', '-e', code]
    process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    output = json.loads(process.stdout)
    assert process.returncode == (0 if output['success'] else 1), name
    record['observations'].append({'id': name, 'source': code, 'command': command, 'intended_success': intended, 'exit_code': process.returncode, 'output': output, 'stderr': process.stderr})
    print(name, output['success'], flush=True)
record['source_stable'] = digest_source(root) == source_before
record['binary_stable'] = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == record['binary_sha256']
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
assert record['source_stable'] and record['binary_stable']
if phase != 'before':
    assert all(o['output']['success'] == o['intended_success'] for o in record['observations'])
print('Stable:', record['source_sha256'], record['binary_sha256'])
